### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Guard rails for fanning work out across multiple subagents. Use when about to spawn several parallel or background Agent calls for research, surveys, audits, or any broad multi-part task. Prevents recursive agent explosions (agents spawning agents that return "I'll wait / will report" placeholders) that silently multiply into dozens of processes, burn tokens, and trip rate limits.
